source: USGS 3DEP LiDAR MA_CentralEastern_2021_B21 (2021); roof planes fitted per building and snapped to the footprint
layout: per building: int16 x[n], uint16 y[n], int16 z[n] in cm (x,z relative to the building centre), then uint16 indices[3t]; index = [offset, vertices, triangles, eave height m, roof type]
